name: ENIGMA-Epilepsy summary statistics (via ENIGMA Toolbox)

access.licence: Toolbox open source; individual data via consortium
access.steps: pip install enigmatoolbox or clone; load_summary_stats('epilepsy').

cohort.types: all epilepsies, GGE, left/right MTLE-HS, all-other

format: CSV: Cohen's d, SE, CI, n, p, FDR per DK region (68 cortical thickness, 16 subcortical volumes)
checks: Cloned toolbox; listed 10 epilepsy CSVs and read allepi_case-controls_CortThick.csv header.
pipeline: Group atrophy maps as a structural prior on DK regions.
key_claim: Open regional effect sizes from 2,149 patients vs 1,727 controls.

evidence.quote: Structural brain measures were extracted from MRI brain scans across 2149 individuals with epilepsy
